customers.evidence: We work every day to deliver innovative medicines for patients with serious and life-threatening diseases.

employees.evidence: Each day, our employees around the world work together for patients

dei.evidence: Our workforce is globally diverse to create an inclusive, high-performance culture that is agile, entrepreneurial and accountable.

environment.evidence: Preservation of natural resources is one of our key commitments.

community.evidence: Through the Bristol-Myers Squibb Foundation, we promote health equity and strive to improve health outcomes of populations disproportionately affected by serious diseases

integrity.evidence: Our policies and procedures are designed so that the company and our partners conduct business in a legal, ethical and responsible manner.

innovation.evidence: Through our R&D organization, we have built a sustainable pipeline of potential therapies

result.analyst_notes: Mostly factual, with aspirational mission language around patients. Patients are addressed first, then employees and community. Uses first-person plural and hedged verbs such as seek to and strive to. Integrity is anchored by an ethics quotation. Safety and shareholders are absent.
